schema_ddl:
CREATE TABLE ACTIVITY (
    PLAYER_ID INT,
    EVENT_DATE DATE,
    DEVICE_ID INT,
    GAMES_PLAYED INT,
    PRIMARY KEY (PLAYER_ID, EVENT_DATE),
    CHECK (GAMES_PLAYED >= 0)
);
q1: SELECT A1.FIRST_LOGIN AS INSTALL_DT, COUNT(DISTINCT A1.PLAYER_ID) AS INSTALLS, ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN (A1.FIRST_LOGIN + 1) = A2.EVENT_DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/ COUNT(DISTINCT A1.PLAYER_ID)), 2) AS DAY1_RETENTION FROM (SELECT PLAYER_ID, MIN(EVENT_DATE) AS FIRST_LOGIN FROM ACTIVITY GROUP BY PLAYER_ID) AS A1 JOIN ACTIVITY AS A2 ON A1.PLAYER_ID = A2.PLAYER_ID GROUP BY A1.FIRST_LOGIN
q2: SELECT INSTALL_DT, COUNT(DISTINCT A1.PLAYER_ID) AS INSTALLS, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(EVENT_DATE, INSTALL_DT) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END )/ COUNT(DISTINCT A1.PLAYER_ID), 2) AS DAY1_RETENTION FROM ( SELECT PLAYER_ID, MIN(EVENT_DATE) AS INSTALL_DT FROM ACTIVITY GROUP BY PLAYER_ID ) AS A1 JOIN ACTIVITY AS A2 ON A1.PLAYER_ID = A2.PLAYER_ID GROUP BY INSTALL_DT

explanation: Both queries aim to calculate the number of installs and the day-1 retention rate. They achieve this by identifying the first login date for each player and then checking how many of these players have an event on the day immediately following their first login.
